summary: Barclays PLC furnished a 6-K disclosing routine PDMR/PCA shareholding notifications rather than any special situation. Group Chief Executive C.S. Venkatakrishnan received 315,573 American Depositary Shares on 2026-09-16 following conversion of ordinary shares held by Computershare Investor Services plc, then transferred the same 315,573 ADSs on 2026-09-18 into a joint account with PCA P. Venkatakrishnan. Each ADS represents four ordinary shares of 25 pence nominal value. Both transactions occurred outside a trading venue at no stated price, with no board recommendation, advisor, premium, or deal terms disclosed.
